value: affirmative form takes the subjunctive : je doute qu'il comprenne
negative form can take the indicative when certainty dominates : je ne doute pas qu'il comprend

evidence.notes: Usage note states the affirmative takes the subjunctive and the negative may take the indicative when certainty dominates; source example is affirmative. Confidence high on the affirmative, moderate on the negative variant.

value: de + le → du
destination counterpart : au Brésil

evidence.notes: Source example 'Elle est originaire du Brésil' shows the contraction du; au marks the destination. Confidence high.

value: de elides before a vowel : décider d'aller
passé composé : j'ai décidé d'aller au cinéma

evidence.notes: Source examples 'J'ai décidé d'aller au cinéma' and 'Nous avons décidé d'aller au Japon' show the elision and the passé composé. Confidence high.

value: followed by the subjunctive
requires a subject different from the main clause

evidence.notes: Listed restriction requires different subjects; source example 'Vous désirez que nous suivions un cours d'informatique' shows the subjunctive. Confidence high.

value: en + country without an article
masculine countries take au instead : au Canada

evidence.notes: Listed restrictions cover feminine or vowel-initial masculine countries; source example 'en Sicile'. Confidence high.

value: en + state without an article
masculine states beginning with a consonant take dans le : dans le Midi

evidence.notes: Source entry gives 'la Pennsylvanie en Pennsylvanie'; the related grammar rule contrasts en, au and dans le. Confidence high.

value: exceptions take en instead of à : en Haïti, en Martinique, en Guadeloupe
most other islands take à : à Cuba, à Madagascar

evidence.notes: Listed restriction names Haïti, Martinique and Guadeloupe; the related grammar rule contrasts à, aux and en for islands. Confidence high.

value: followed by the subjunctive
same subject → en attendant de + infinitif

evidence.notes: Usage note states the subjunctive is required and the de + infinitive variant is used with the same subject. Confidence high.

value: invariable
used with the present tense for an action in progress

evidence.notes: Fixed time expression; en ce moment normally co-occurs with the present tense. Confidence high on invariability, moderate on the tense association.

value: followed by the subjunctive
requires a subject different from the main clause

evidence.notes: Source example 'J'exige que vous arriviez à l'heure' shows the subjunctive with a distinct subject. Confidence high.
